pages.text: A $(item)Bounty Board$() is an old wanted board with four poster screens. Each poster shows a player with a price on their head: their face, the reward, how long it has left and who offered it, the biggest first.$(br2)Its keys open $(l)BOARD$(), $(l)PLACE$() and $(l)HUNTS$().
Dark oak, two glass panes, a Basic Control Circuit and a gold ingot. Place it anywhere; it breaks with an axe.

The bounties are the same on every server of the network. $(l)WANTED$() shows them all, six at a time, with a search and a sort. $(l)MY HUNTS$() shows the bounties you accepted, and $(l)MY BOUNTIES$() the ones you put up.$(br2)Score Screens can show the $(l)Most Wanted$() board.
